verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's own docs describe built-in AI browser agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, BrowserUse) that run in its managed cloud sessions. You hand off a task with a single API call and can watch it execute live. HyperAgent's natural-language page.ai() commands add another way to delegate tasks. Delegation is API- and SDK-driven, not an interactive assistant in the product UI. missing for 10: evidence of an in-product (dashboard/chat) assistant experience, independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated agent tasks complete reliably, detail on task results and supervision.
